text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After taking care of some errands while out,
I was walking back to Tracen Academy when..."

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Excuse me, young lady, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
...My goodness, I knew it!
Do you remember me? We spoke once on the train before...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
!
You're...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: “—Oh my. A footbath?”

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman in the Next Seat
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the view is lovely, and you can even rent yukatas.
It's such a wonderful place~"
choice_data_list: —Ah, the old lady from back then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, since standing around chatting seemed silly,
we went to the shop recommended by the old woman.

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
You went straight to the footbath after that, didn't you?
I'm so glad. How was it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that felt so wonderful.
We even borrowed yukatas and could just relax and stretch our legs...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Also, I had a lovely chat
with your footbath friends, Grandmother♪

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I heard about it when we met recently~.
Next time, come with me too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Elegant Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! There's a spot near here
with a really wonderful view!
There's no footbath, but... you should definitely check it out♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with the old woman at the shop,
since I had the chance, I visited that place, but—
choice_data_list: Ah, so this place really is...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... This is where
you and I spoke for the first time, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"‘It’s all right... It's all right.
There’s nothing to be afraid of.’"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't you come over here for a moment?
Come on—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning in this very spot,
she was trying to rescue a weakened stray cat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what was wrong and calling out to her
was the exact moment our connection was formed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I never imagined I would visit this place again like this...
choice_data_list: Yeah, the bonds between people really are mysterious.
Yeah, the connections between people are truly mysterious.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"An acquaintance of yours took in the cat,
right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's grown bigger than before.
I wonder if it's doing well...

text_block_list.name: Male Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
Could that be... over there...?

text_block_list.name: Male Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it! Hey there, long time no see!
Has it been since we adopted that cat?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To my surprise, the person who spoke to me was the benefactor who took in the stray cat I found.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Long time no see. ...Is the cat doing well?

text_block_list.name: Cat Adopter
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm doing well.
Ever since she arrived, every single day has been so joyful.

text_block_list.name: Cat Adopter
text_block_list.text:
Why are you two here?
Did you find another stray cat or something?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, no. An acquaintance recommended it, saying "There's a place with a wonderful view," and when I came to check it out, it turned out to be here.

text_block_list.name: Cat Adopter
text_block_list.text: A place with a lovely view, huh... In that case, I know the perfect spot!

text_block_list.name: Cat Adopter
text_block_list.text:
As thanks for introducing me to such a wonderful family,
I'll let just the two of you in on a special secret!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Breathtaking." That was the only word for it.
Even the rustling of the leaves felt beautiful.
choice_data_list: Getting to see this stunning view is all thanks to Pisa.
Getting to see this stunning view is all thanks to Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a view she could only reach because of her
desire to cherish connections and broaden her circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I may have mentioned this before,
but this is truly not an accomplishment I achieved alone."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I may have been the one
who started it, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A boy I met through storytime grew to love books,
and his mother gave me some taiyaki—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The circle of happiness spread not only to the cat I picked up that day, but also to its owner—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I met you, Trainer, I've...
come to cherish my bonds with others
even more than before.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much, Trainer.
For coming back to that park in the rain that day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming into my life.
choice_data_list: Let's keep expanding our circle even more.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming into my life.
choice_data_list: Let's keep expanding our circle even more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meeting Victoire Pisa made me realize once again how important human connections are.
choice_data_list: Thank you for coming into my life, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Saying it again out loud feels a bit embarrassing, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: More than that, though... I am very happy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's true.
Your face is bright red.
choice_data_list: No... it's just embarrassing when you say it so directly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I wonder which is redder, this or the sunset? ...May I take a closer look?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Bigger and bigger, larger than anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Right. Would you like to go on an outing
together like this again sometime?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Next... I'd like to visit
a place connected to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To expand the circle between you and me even further.
